units.source_text: 就以但丁和斯威登堡来说吧，这些西方人对那个世界的幻想，一般比佛典中有关佛爷群居的世界的幻想更现实些，

en.t: Take Dante and Swedenborg, for example: these Westerners' imaginings of that other world are generally more realistic than the Buddhist scriptures' imaginings of a world where the Buddhas dwell together,
and they are also small, weak, and vulgar.

units.source_text: 在东方，也有个孔子，虽然他简洁地将这些归纳为“未知生，焉知死”，

en.t: In the East, too, there was Confucius; although he summed these matters up concisely as, "If you do not yet understand life, how can you understand death?"

units.source_text: 可我此时此刻则认为佛典阐述的前世和来世的幻想曲，是无与伦比的难得的抒情诗。

en.t: at this very moment I believe that the fantasy of past and future lives set forth in the Buddhist scriptures is an incomparable and rare lyric poem.
